name: tokkey
description: Tokkey desktop application built with Electron
author: qi liu

scripts.build: tsc && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:assets
scripts.build:prod: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.prod.json && npm run build:renderer -- --minify && npm run build:assets
scripts.build:assets: mkdir -p dist/renderer && cp src/renderer/index.html dist/renderer/index.html && rm -rf dist/renderer/assets && cp -R src/renderer/assets dist/renderer/assets && npm run build:css
scripts.package:mac: npm run build:prod && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac --arm64 --dir --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run gateway:freeze && npm run build:prod && TOKKEY_RELEASE=1 electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac --arm64 --publish never
scripts.gateway:freeze: cd runtime/amis-gateway/packaging && uv run --project .. --with pyinstaller --frozen pyinstaller --noconfirm --distpath "../../../resources/GatewayRuntime/$(node -p 'process.arch')" --workpath ../build amis-gateway.spec
scripts.start: npm run gateway:freeze && npm run build && npm run kill:app && node scripts/electron-dev.js .
scripts.dev: npm run gateway:freeze && npm run build && npm run kill:app && node scripts/electron-dev.js . --dev
scripts.evidence: npm run gateway:freeze && npm run build && npm run kill:app && node scripts/electron-dev.js . --evidence
